sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for outlining your cost drivers; we would expect a materially lower fixed unit price in return for a longer contract commitment. Please send your cost-breakdown workbook in XLSX format so we can examine the individual elements, particularly the material component against recent alloy-index movements. We are open to discussing payment terms alongside that commitment to support a more competitive price.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -0.3% from 2026-03 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.77 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract, which allows us to reduce our price to EUR 5.40 per unit. However, for a contract of this duration, we cannot offer a fixed price and must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility. 

Our current proposal is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

We acknowledge your requirement for indexation, but our longer-term commitment must secure a more competitive base price. Our counterproposal retains that commitment and unchanged payment terms while asking you to reconsider fixed pricing. If indexation remains essential, it must be exchanged for a lower base price and include a meaningful deadband.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.86 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always strive to support your needs with our high service standards and broad product range.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

In response to your movement, we are lowering our base price to EUR 5.10 per unit for a 24-month contract, with the required AS-14404 index clause. For this offer, we outline a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.20 per unit. For this alternative package, the terms are a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please understand that we do not share detailed cost-breakdown spreadsheets beyond the 45% material share already disclosed. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for reducing the base price; we acknowledge that you have presented this as your final offer. We note your limits on detailed cost disclosure and ask for an XLSX breakdown of the pricing elements you can share. In view of the proposed contract commitment and required index clause, please consider one final modest base-price reduction within your approval authority so we can conclude on that basis.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months.

We accept your alternative as you proposed it; it is attached as a term sheet for your confirmation.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
